description: Kirana voice-command evaluation set. `tts_text` is the Devanagari spelling fed to the offline Hindi TTS voices to synthesise audio (English words are written phonetically so a Hindi voice pronounces them the way a shopkeeper would). `reference` is the Romanized reference transcript used for WER. `quantities` and `products` are the tokens that must survive transcription for the command to be usable downstream. `language` is the dominant language of the utterance.
